name: dsh-goalloop-agentteams
description: Deterministic goal-completion gate + goal loop for DeepSeek Harness: contract-first AC grammar, re-runs every AC check itself (zero model trust), binds verdicts to a tree digest (R7), hard-denies false goal completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter (2 catches -> BLOCKED), scope-aware task-claim handling (exit: strict|goal-only), and drives the agentic loop from /goal-loop-at with score/trend/round metrics (history.jsonl). Ports goal-loop's judging + loop faces onto native Agent Teams + task board.
